digest.en: Asia-Pacific leads the board this hour with Taiwan won't be sacrificed, U.S. arms sales a commitment: President responds to Trump. Americas carries the next thread. 19 fresh dispatches in this edition.
digest.hi: इस घंटे बोर्ड पर एशिया-प्रशांत की अगुवाई है, डिजिटल युग में रचनात्मक सोच के माध्यम से राजनीतिक सूझबूझ विकसित करना। मुख्य खबर है। साथ ही यूरोप और रूस से भी घटनाक्रम सामने आया है। कुल 25 ताज़ा खबरें इस संस्करण में हैं।

articles.title: Trump administration promotes program to check voter eligibility; critics fear a midterm purge
articles.summary: The Trump administration promotes a national program to scan state voter rolls. The scanning of state voter rolls at the national level is part of a broader effort by Republican President Donald Trump to federalise certain election functions and promote his messaging that elections are marred by noncitizen voting, even though instances of that are rare.

articles.title: Anwar says ready to call GE and ‘fight’ BN after it signals intent to go solo in Johor
articles.summary: Prime Minister Anwar Ibrahim stated he is prepared to call a general election and contest against Barisan Nasional. This comes after Barisan Nasional signaled its intent to contest the Johor state polls independently. Anwar described this move as a potential betrayal of their unity government partnership.

articles.summary: Canadian officials confirmed a presumptive hantavirus case in British Columbia. articles.title: Donald Trump does ‘not feel optimistic’ for Jimmy Lai after speaking with Xi Jinping
articles.summary: United States President Donald Trump spoke with Chinese leader Xi Jinping about jailed Hong Kong activist Jimmy Lai. Trump raised Lai's case during their talks. Xi Jinping described the situation as "a tough one." Lai's family had hoped for his release.

articles.title: Colorado governor commuted Tina Peters’ sentence after Trump blocked funding for clean water
articles.summary: Steve Cohen will not seek re-election to the U. S. House of Representatives. Tennessee's Republican-controlled legislature redrew his Memphis-based district. Cohen stated the new map was designed to defeat him. He has represented the ninth congressional district since 2007.

articles.title: Trump’s lack of focus on human rights in China is big departure for US diplomacy
articles.summary: Donald Trump did not raise the case of jailed activist Jimmy Lai with Chinese President Xi Jinping in Beijing. Trump stated he would bring up Lai's case before his departure. He then compared it to asking if he would let former FBI Director James Comey out of jail.

articles.title: Mali’s forces target rebel alliance in junta’s fight to keep power
articles.summary: Mali's armed forces, aided by Russian mercenaries, conducted airstrikes against a coalition of Islamist extremists and Tuareg separatists. This offensive follows an advance by the rebel alliance. The junta is working to retain control amid the ongoing conflict in the west African nation.

articles.title: Sudan hunger crisis deepens as UN warns millions face acute food shortages
articles.summary: The United Nations warned that nearly 20 million people in Sudan face acute hunger. Over 800,000 children risk severe malnutrition this year. Civil war, displacement, and collapsing systems are deepening the humanitarian crisis. Parts of the country are nearing famine conditions.

articles.title: As war displaces millions in DR Congo, new schools offer children hope beyond violence
articles.summary: New schools are opening in eastern Democratic Republic of the Congo. Ten-year-old Shadrac Anyazaka does not hesitate when asked about his future. “After finishing my studies, I would like to become President of the Republic one day,” he tells visitors to his school in eastern Democratic Republic of the Congo (DRC).

articles.title: Somalia at ‘real risk of famine’ as Middle East war fallout continues
articles.summary: UN aid teams warned Somalia faces a real risk of famine. At least six million people in Somalia are going days without enough food, UN aid teams warned on Friday, highlighting that nearly two million of this number are young children “at high risk of illness or death”.

articles.title: Furnace Creek sizzles as snow sweeps Siberia in a week of extremes
articles.summary: Honduras recorded its all-time May maximum temperature twice this month. articles.title: HIV prevention and treatment services faltering, warns UNAIDS
articles.summary: UNAIDS warned that HIV prevention and treatment services are faltering. Decades of gains in the fight against AIDS are under growing threat as donor funding declines and community-based health services collapse in some of the world’s most vulnerable countries, the head of the joint UN programme on HIV/AIDS warned on Thursday.

articles.title: Malnutrition in Somalia, hunger crisis in DR Congo, energy shortages in Cuba
articles.summary: UN-backed food security experts warned nearly six million people in Nearly six million people in Somalia – almost a third of the population analysed – are projected to face acute hunger between April and June, with 1.9 million expected to experience emergency levels, UN-backed food security experts warned on Thursday.

articles.title: UN welcomes $1.8 billion US boost for humanitarian operations
articles.summary: The United States announced $1.8 billion in new humanitarian funding. This boost will support United Nations and partner aid operations globally. The funding arrives as rising needs and shortfalls force agencies to reduce assistance. An additional $1.8 billion in US humanitarian funding will allow the United Nations and its partners to expand emergency relief operations reaching millions of people worldwide, as rising global needs and funding shortfalls force aid agencies to scale back assistance.

articles.title: UN pleads for Equatorial Guinea not to send US asylum seekers to their home countries: ‘Their life
articles.summary: United Nations human rights experts publicly urged Equatorial Guinea to stop returning US deportees. The experts cited reports of political violence, torture, and death faced by individuals sent back to their home countries. Deportees described being held in prison-like conditions.

articles.summary: कोलकाता नाइट राइडर्स ने 18 करोड़ रुपये में खरीदे मथीशा पथिराना पहले ही मैच में चोटिल हो गए। वह महंगे खिलाड़ियों में से एक हैं। मथीशा पथिराना को कोलकाता नाइट राइडर्स ने 18 करोड़ रुपये में ख़रीदा था. चोट की वजह से उन्हें बीच मैच में बाहर जाना पड़ा.

articles.title: बांग्लादेशी अफसर अब लाहौर में प्रशिक्षण लेंगे, पहले मसूरी के LBSNAA आते थे
articles.summary: बांग्लादेशी अधिकारी अब पाकिस्तान के लाहौर में प्रशिक्षण लेंगे। पहले वे भारत के मसूरी स्थित लाल बहादुर शास्त्री राष्ट्रीय प्रशासन अकादमी (LBSNAA) में प्रशिक्षण प्राप्त करते थे। पाकिस्तान के साथ बढ़ती नजदीकी: बांग्लादेशी अफसर अब लाहौर में प्रशिक्षण लेंगे, पहले मसूरी आते थे। बांग्लादेशी अफसर अब लाहौर में प्रशिक्षण लेंगे, पहले मसूरी के LBSNAA आते थे।
